aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk due to higher leverage and concentration in volatile assets like leveraged ETFs, which also experience daily decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.
